# Zhihu

> Zhihu is China's leading Q&A and content creation platform enabling users to share knowledge, ask questions, and publish articles across diverse topics.

Zhihu operates as a community-driven platform where users can discover trending content, create columns for publishing, and engage with a large Chinese-speaking audience. The platform is governed by comprehensive terms of service, privacy policies, and compliance with Chinese data protection regulations.

- [Zhihu Discover](https://www.zhihu.com/explore): Zhihu Discover page featuring trending questions, hot topics, and community content
